text:
danny-oncall: deploy-bot queued a hotfix (rev: r2026.03.15-eu-token-fix) to canary (eu1). Unit + smoke tests passed; e2e flaky in staging but failure looks unrelated. Requesting expedited approvals for Infra/Eng-SRE/Product so we can run a 5% canary. tagging @alice @ben @carol. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-15-eu-token-fix TL;DR: fix for token re-encode bug that caused intermittent 502s during reauth under burst load. Expected perf delta ~+3% p99.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled. Strategy: canary=5% -> monitor 10m -> ramp to 25% if green. Rollback threshold = +1.0% 502s over baseline OR any user-visible auth failures. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/eu-token-fix

alice: quick question — what's the baseline 502 rate and current canary test numbers?

ben: baseline 502s = 0.15% (last 24h). In canary smoke we saw 0.18% -> 0.9% for a short spike under synthetic reauth load, then back down. No user data loss seen.

carol: from product POV acceptable if canary only. Need kill-switch and explicit rollback criteria. Approve conditional on rollback guardrails.

ops-runner: agree. Approve if we set alerting: Pager if 502s > baseline +1.0% sustained for 3m OR if any auth error metric >0.5%. Also require deploy pin so we can force traffic back to r2026.03.14 quickly.

alice: ok I give an approval. Setting canary monitor dashboard now. /deploy approve by alice — proceeding if other signoffs arrive. :thumbsup:

ben: I can be on watch for the next 30m. Approve. Will watch logs and tail tokens service (svc-token-eu).

release-bot: pinned r2026.03.15-eu-token-fix to canary-edge-eu. Release note snippet added to internal changelog.

danny-oncall: thanks — we have infra/product/sre approvals. Starting canary rollout now. Will post live metrics here. If threshold breached, immediate rollback.

deploy-bot: canary started: 5% traffic -> instances up. Health hooks passed initial check.

ben: tailing logs — small spike at +0.6% but within threshold.

ops-runner: set temporary alert: /alert create --metric=auth.502 --threshold=baseline+1.0% --window=3m --notify=#oncall ; will escalate to pager if hit.

alice: monitoring dashboard shows latency stable, 502s trending at +0.4% over baseline. Green so far.

carol: product ok to continue to 25% after 10m if no degradation.

deploy-bot: ramping to 25% as per plan.

ben: still watching. No new 502 spikes.

release-bot: note: document for this hotfix pushed to /releases/2026-03-15 with rollback steps and manual rollback command: `deploy rollback --to r2026.03.14 --immediate`.

danny-oncall: final: canary -> 25% successful, no escalation. We'll keep observing for 30m before full rollout. Thanks for fast approvals team. :rocket:
